purpose: Define msg messaging as peer-to-peer identity-addressed communication over WebRTC, with rendezvous used only for peer bootstrap and no central application-payload authority.

topics.name: P2P Messaging
topics.purpose: Define msg messaging as peer-to-peer identity-addressed communication over WebRTC, with rendezvous used only for peer bootstrap and no central application-payload authority.

semantics.rendezvous_rule: Rendezvous/signaling provides peer discovery/bootstrap metadata only.
semantics.identity_rule: Messaging peer identity is explicit semantic identity and is separate from transient transport/session identifiers.
semantics.authority_rule: Receiving a message does not grant runtime/data authority.
semantics.conversation_rule: Conversation state is scoped to explicit participants/group identity.
semantics.ui_rule: Irssi-style or other UI is projection only; message semantics are independent of client presentation.

invariants.rule: Messaging identity, conversation state, throttling, group governance and transport semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: message payload routed through rendezvous as default application payload path
transport/session id used as semantic peer identity
client UI semantics become message authority

prose.summary: Define msg messaging as peer-to-peer identity-addressed communication over WebRTC, with rendezvous used only for peer bootstrap and no central application-payload authority.
